rounds.text: Arihant Superstructures Ltd trades at attractive multiples relative to sector benchmarks, with a P/E of 24.13x compared to the sector benchmark of 33.03x and an EV/EBITDA of 15.01x against 22.37x [E6, E11]. The company demonstrates superior operational efficiency, delivering an ROA of 2.6% over the sector's 1.39%, an ROE of 12.67% against 5.78%, and an ROCE of 10.4% versus 3.14% [E8, E9, E10]. Profitability catalysts are already visible as quarterly operating margins surged by 16 percentage points to 14% in March 2026, while yearly operating margins expanded by 4 percentage points to 29% [E30, E31]. Recent operational performance is further underscored by strong top-line momentum, featuring a 190% YoY sales surge alongside quarter-on-quarter increases in both sales and profit [E68, E70, E71]. Conceded: the company faces negative free cash flow of Rs -66.54 Cr and a high leverage risk with debt-to-equity at 1.77x [E36, E38]. Yet, growth spending is actively underway as evidenced by Capital Work-in-Progress expanding by 477.3% to Rs 20.09 Cr [E40], positioning the business to capture upside as institutional money flow remains positive [E44].
